title: Assistance needed in Aisle 1: What Missouri WIC families face
summary_en: Bursky Public Health and Brown School teams surveyed nearly 2,900 participants and co-developed retailer training to boost nutrition access during pregnancy and early childhood.

title: Carolina Caycedo on ‘Growing Deep Roots’
summary_en: “Growing Deep Roots,” a one-person show by artist Carolina Caycedo, will open Sept. 9 at the WashU Kemper Art Museum. In this Q&A, Caycedo discusses her work, her interest in migration, just energy transitions and the tenacity of repair.

title: ‘The Color Purple’ opens Black Rep’s 50th season
summary_en: The Black Rep will launch its 50th anniversary season Sept. 11 with the Tony Award-winning musical “The Color Purple” in WashU’s Edison Theatre.
